access.mechanism: Data Access Request through dbGaP using an eRA Commons account; institutional signing official approval required
access.typical_turnaround: days to a few weeks after signing official approval
access.citation_requirement: Cite the dataset accession and the program's publication guidelines; see the GDC publication policy.
access.license: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy terms

evidence.note: Index strategy epmc-index-v1. Every dataset is measured with the same fields so the counts are comparable; per-tier value is the maximum across that tier's fields and across the dataset's accessions.
